title: Open restriction of derived pullback with independent universes
statement: Let f:X→Y be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], U⊆X and V⊆Y opens with U⊆f⁻¹(V). Write R_U and R_V for exact module restriction followed by the over equivalences. Choose ambient derived categories with common localization universe w and open-subscheme derived categories with common localization universe wO, possibly different from w. There is a natural isomorphism Lf* followed by R_U.mapDerivedCategory ≅ R_V.mapDerivedCategory followed by L(f.resLE V U)* [def-pc-derived-pullback]. No affineness or quasi-coherence assumption is required.

proof.text: Apply derivedPullback_openRestriction_iso with HasDerivedCategory.standard for the four module-sheaf categories, obtaining the standard same-universe natural comparison.

For each chosen localization of the homotopy category, form Localization.uniq to its standard localization. Exact restriction commutes with these equivalences: compose mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh with compUniqFunctor and lift the resulting isomorphism by the fully faithful precomposition with Qh. Derived pullback commutes with the equivalences as well: extract its left-derived counit from exists_derivedPullback, identify the two underlying tensor pullback functors using their recorded object and map equalities, and transport the right Kan extension across both equivalences. Postcomposition acts by an equivalence on right extensions; precomposition uses isRightKanExtension_iff_postcomp₁. Apply rightKanExtensionUniqueOfIso.

Compose the two restriction transport isomorphisms, the two pullback transport isomorphisms, and the standard comparison using isoWhiskerLeft and isoWhiskerRight. This identifies the claimed composites after postcomposition with the open-source localization equivalence. Cancel it using preimageIso for the fully faithful right-whiskering functor.

lean.statement:
theorem derivedPullback_openRestriction_iso_universes {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (U : X.Opens) (V : Y.Opens) (hUV : U ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wO} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wO} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings V.toScheme.toRingedSpace))] :
    Nonempty (derivedPullback f ⋙
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U ⋙
        Equivalence.functor
          (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
          (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
          (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory ≅
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace) V ⋙
        Equivalence.functor
          (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over V))
          (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings V.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
          (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V)).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        derivedPullback (f.resLE V U hUV))
